dict.string: 每天最多上报一次：设备的随机安装号（开发者范围内的标识的哈希）、游戏、平台和版本，用来统计日活、周活、月活和流失率。不发名字、账号或游戏文件；网站只存安装号的加盐哈希，不存 IP · Once a day: a random install id of the device (a hash of the vendor id), the game, platform and version, to count daily, weekly and monthly players. No name, account or game file; the site keeps only a salted hash of the id and no IP
匿名统计活跃度 · Count me as an active player
